newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday in lacklustre trading as sentiment dampened after the Corporate Law Authority removed a member from Karachi and Lahore stock exchanges, dealers said.

"People are demoralised after this incident," dealer Dawar Hasan said. "There is a lot of uncertainity among investors because earlier, membership of M. Rashid Jamal's MRJ Securities was also suspended for default by the Karachi exchange."
The index fell 3.31 points, or 0.21 percent, to end at 1,578.21. Losers led gainers 184 to 92. PTCL fell 0.30 to 30.90 rupees. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
